Extract the surviving cohort from a flow object

Source: R/flow.R
cohort.Rd

Returns the rows that passed all criteria (or, with a step selector, all criteria up to a chosen step), with the internal .cf_row_id column removed.

Usage

cohort(
  flow,
  flag = FALSE,
  at = NULL,
  step_number = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  category = NULL
)

Arguments

flow

A cf_flow object produced by apply_criteria().

flag

Logical. When FALSE (default), returns only the surviving rows (the historical behaviour). When TRUE, returns all original rows, in their original order, with attribution columns added instead of filtering: cf_included (logical), cf_excluded_step (integer, NA if included), cf_excluded_label (character, NA if included), and cf_excluded_category (character, NA if uncategorised or included). Useful when downstream code needs every row present (e.g. plotting a full recording) while still knowing which rows count. Combined with a step selector, attribution only considers steps up to that step; rows removed later count as included.

at

Optional automatic step selector (number, label or category); see the section "Intermediate steps".

step_number

Optional whole step number (0 = starting data).

label

Optional exact step label.

category

Optional category name (last step in that category).

Value

A tibble.

Intermediate steps

A selector picks a step and means "up to and including that step". With none given, the last step is used. At most one may be given:

  • step_number: a whole number k from 0 to the number of steps; 0 is the starting data.

  • label: an exact step label. Errors if no step, or several steps, have it.

  • category: a category name; selects the last step in that category.

  • at: picks automatically. A number is a step_number; a string is a label if one matches, else a category. A string that is both a label and a category is an error: use label or category explicitly.

See also

criteria_status() for each row's result on every criterion.

Other flow accessors: criteria_status(), excluded(), stack_cohorts()

Examples

dat  <- mock_parallel_rct(n_participants = 200, seed = 1)
crit <- cf_criteria() |>
  include(~ !is.na(age), label = "Age recorded") |>
  include(~ eligible_screen, label = "Passed screening") |>
  exclude(~ withdrew, label = "Withdrew consent")
flow <- apply_criteria(dat, crit)
#> No `id` supplied and no `.cf_row_id` column found. Adding a sequential `.cf_row_id`.
cohort(flow)                            # final survivors
#> # A tibble: 167 × 10
#>    participant_id arm            age age_group sex   ethnicity eligible_screen
#>    <chr>          <chr>        <dbl> <chr>     <chr> <chr>     <lgl>          
#>  1 P0002          Intervention    46 40-64     M     Pacific   TRUE           
#>  2 P0003          Control         31 18-39     M     European  TRUE           
#>  3 P0004          Control         47 40-64     F     European  TRUE           
#>  4 P0005          Intervention    35 18-39     F     Pacific   TRUE           
#>  5 P0006          Control         72 65+       F     Pacific   TRUE           
#>  6 P0007          Control         56 40-64     M     European  TRUE           
#>  7 P0008          Control         59 40-64     F     Maori     TRUE           
#>  8 P0010          Intervention    70 65+       F     European  TRUE           
#>  9 P0011          Control         35 18-39     M     Maori     TRUE           
#> 10 P0013          Control         66 65+       F     Asian     TRUE           
#> # ℹ 157 more rows
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: consent_date <date>, baseline_complete <lgl>,
#> #   withdrew <lgl>
cohort(flow, at = "Passed screening")   # screening cohort (auto-select)
#> # A tibble: 174 × 10
#>    participant_id arm            age age_group sex   ethnicity eligible_screen
#>    <chr>          <chr>        <dbl> <chr>     <chr> <chr>     <lgl>          
#>  1 P0002          Intervention    46 40-64     M     Pacific   TRUE           
#>  2 P0003          Control         31 18-39     M     European  TRUE           
#>  3 P0004          Control         47 40-64     F     European  TRUE           
#>  4 P0005          Intervention    35 18-39     F     Pacific   TRUE           
#>  5 P0006          Control         72 65+       F     Pacific   TRUE           
#>  6 P0007          Control         56 40-64     M     European  TRUE           
#>  7 P0008          Control         59 40-64     F     Maori     TRUE           
#>  8 P0010          Intervention    70 65+       F     European  TRUE           
#>  9 P0011          Control         35 18-39     M     Maori     TRUE           
#> 10 P0012          Control         38 18-39     F     Asian     TRUE           
#> # ℹ 164 more rows
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: consent_date <date>, baseline_complete <lgl>,
#> #   withdrew <lgl>
cohort(flow, label = "Passed screening") # same, explicit
#> # A tibble: 174 × 10
#>    participant_id arm            age age_group sex   ethnicity eligible_screen
#>    <chr>          <chr>        <dbl> <chr>     <chr> <chr>     <lgl>          
#>  1 P0002          Intervention    46 40-64     M     Pacific   TRUE           
#>  2 P0003          Control         31 18-39     M     European  TRUE           
#>  3 P0004          Control         47 40-64     F     European  TRUE           
#>  4 P0005          Intervention    35 18-39     F     Pacific   TRUE           
#>  5 P0006          Control         72 65+       F     Pacific   TRUE           
#>  6 P0007          Control         56 40-64     M     European  TRUE           
#>  7 P0008          Control         59 40-64     F     Maori     TRUE           
#>  8 P0010          Intervention    70 65+       F     European  TRUE           
#>  9 P0011          Control         35 18-39     M     Maori     TRUE           
#> 10 P0012          Control         38 18-39     F     Asian     TRUE           
#> # ℹ 164 more rows
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: consent_date <date>, baseline_complete <lgl>,
#> #   withdrew <lgl>
nrow(cohort(flow, step_number = 0))     # the starting data
#> [1] 200
excluded(flow, at = 2)                  # removed by steps 1-2
#> # A tibble: 26 × 15
#>    participant_id arm            age age_group sex   ethnicity eligible_screen
#>    <chr>          <chr>        <dbl> <chr>     <chr> <chr>     <lgl>          
#>  1 P0077          Intervention    NA NA        F     European  TRUE           
#>  2 P0078          Control         NA NA        M     European  TRUE           
#>  3 P0114          Intervention    NA NA        M     Asian     TRUE           
#>  4 P0115          Intervention    NA NA        F     Maori     TRUE           
#>  5 P0140          Control         NA NA        M     European  FALSE          
#>  6 P0159          Intervention    NA NA        F     Other     TRUE           
#>  7 P0194          Intervention    NA NA        M     European  TRUE           
#>  8 P0195          Intervention    NA NA        F     European  TRUE           
#>  9 P0197          Control         NA NA        F     Asian     TRUE           
#> 10 P0199          Control         NA NA        F     Pacific   TRUE           
#> # ℹ 16 more rows
#> # ℹ 8 more variables: consent_date <date>, baseline_complete <lgl>,
#> #   withdrew <lgl>, .cf_row_id <int>, cf_step <int>, cf_label <chr>,
#> #   cf_type <chr>, cf_category <chr>
